_comment: 'If it's defended by an attack action card' was authored as DURING_TURN with a condition:'DEFENDED_BY_ATTACK_ACTION_CARD' string. DURING_TURN reads phase and player and has no 'condition' parameter, so the gate was dropped and the Vigor token was created on EVERY resolution -- including against an undefended attack. Now a real count over the declared defenders: type Action AND subtype Attack, which is what an attack action card is.
